entities.name: Ambrellin
entities.description: A dryad of the Selesnya Conclave on Ravnica and friend and host of Terrik.

entities.name: Terrik
entities.description: Selesnyan haunted by an accident, seeking redemption, who leads an exploration beneath an Orzhov basilica.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: Ravnican guild of harmony and community.

entities.name: Savaryn
entities.description: Companion of Terrik who helped Ambrellin activate the machine.

entities.name: Bazda
entities.description: Young orphan Terrik wishes to help; he secretly stashed the machine's missing piece.

entities.name: Orzhov pontiff
entities.description: Desperate Orzhov pontiff who ran an underground gold-minting operation, later fused with a thrull.

entities.name: Orzhov basilica
entities.description: Ruined basilica above the catacombs the group explores.

events.summary: Ambrellin challenges Terrik about his unresolved grief and obsession with atoning for his past mistakes.
events.quote: challenged him about his unresolved grief and obsession with atoning for his past mistakes

events.summary: Terrik proposes exploring beneath the ruined Orzhov basilica; they find a catacomb of relics and dangers.
events.quote: Their exploration led to a catacomb where they discovered ancient relics

events.summary: Trapped after a collapse, the group argues and Ambrellin voices her grievances to Terrik.
events.quote: who finally voiced her grievances about his behavior

events.summary: They find the pontiff's underground operation using Izzet technology to mint gold, and are forced into labor.
events.quote: Terrik's group was forced into labor

events.summary: Terrik destroys the pontiff's contract book, freeing the spirits temporarily.
events.quote: destroying the pontiff's contract book, temporarily freeing the spirits

events.summary: Terrik pushes the pontiff into a pit; Ambrellin and Savaryn activate the machine, making gold to pay their debts, and Terrik asserts their freedom.
events.quote: Ambrellin successfully activated the machine with Savaryn's help

events.summary: The group escapes riding a wurm and reunites with Bazda's parents, offering a fresh start.
events.quote: They reunited with Bazda's parents and offered them a fresh start.

relations.quote: part of the Selesnya Conclave on the plane of Ravnica
